changelog:
# ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf framework
* Enhanced device discovery for improved connectivity

# 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with repeated device restarts due to Wi-Fi disconnection
* Resolved bug causing incorrect reporting of device battery levels
* Corrected issue with device failing to connect to Matter network

# 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 secret in the codebase, requiring attention for removal
* Security score remains at 0/10, indicating significant room for improvement
* No critical CVEs detected in this release

# ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage, currently at 43.9% of total capacity
* Potential saving of 95 KB identified for future optimization
* No AI patches applied to improve performance in this release

# 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 4 tests to validate device functionality and connectivity
* Code review highlighted areas for improvement in security and performance
* No patches applied in this release, indicating a need for future updates

# ✅ Quality Gates
* Build process completed successfully with no errors
* Tests generated and executed to validate device functionality
* Quality gates passed, allowing for release of firmware v111

# ⚠️ Known Issues
* Security score of 0/10 indicates significant security vulnerabilities
* Presence of 1 secret in the codebase poses a security risk
* Device may experience connectivity issues in certain network environments

# 🔜 Next Release
* Prioritize removal of secrets and improvement of security score
* Apply AI patches to optimize performance and reduce flash usage
* Focus on resolving known issues and improving overall device stability
